import os,subprocess,uuid,json
from pathlib import Path
parent=Path(os.environ['SWARM_BIBA_STDIO_EVIDENCE_PARENT']).resolve()
if not parent.is_dir():raise RuntimeError('Evidence parent must exist')
driver=Path(os.environ['SWARM_BIBA_STDIO_DRIVER']).resolve()
pin=os.environ['SWARM_BIBA_STDIO_DRIVER_SHA256']
out=parent/('biba-git-stdio-'+uuid.uuid4().hex)
subprocess.run(['python3','tests/rust_biba_linux_boundary.py','--scenario','git-stdio','--driver',str(driver),'--driver-sha256',pin,'--output',str(out)],check=True)
result=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_bytes())
if result.get('status')!='PASS' or result.get('scenario')!='git-stdio' or result.get('driver_sha256')!=pin or result.get('python_optimization')!=0:raise RuntimeError('Targeted stdio result is incomplete or has another driver')
print('BIBA_GIT_STDIO_EVIDENCE '+str(out))
